info.name: Aura School System API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Aura School System (v2.0, Multi-Tenant SaaS) — NestJS + Mongoose.

Auth legend from docs: 🔓 Public, 🔐 JwtAuthGuard only, 🛡️ JwtAuthGuard + AbilitiesGuard.

Set `baseUrl` and `token` (JWT from /auth/login, /admin/login) in the collection variables or an environment. Requests marked 'No Auth' in this doc are public per the source documentation, but note the docs also state schoolId is always derived from the JWT server-side for tenant scoping — in practice you likely still need a token for most of these in a live multi-tenant deployment.
